terminal_objects.source_locator: BE-AGH-2026-BSW-WAHLPROGRAMM, physical PDF page 14 of 66, normalized source unit 2, effect atom 2 of 3
terminal_objects.source_excerpt: Wir wollen eine Rückbesinnung auf verbindliche Inhalte, klare Leistungsstandards und überprüfbare Ergebnisse.
terminal_objects.policy: verbindliche Inhalte, klare Leistungsstandards, überprüfbare Ergebnisse
terminal_objects.mechanism: Clearer curriculum/expectations and feedback can improve instructional coherence and transparency; excessive standardisation/high-stakes measurement can narrow curriculum, induce teaching-to-test and disadvantage heterogeneous learning needs.

material_risks: inequitable consequences if standards are not paired with support
terminal_objects.reality_check: Learning progress across domains, inequality gaps, student wellbeing, repetition/dropout and teacher workload; test scores alone are insufficient.
terminal_objects.competence: Primarily Berlin school/curriculum/quality governance, subject to constitutional/equal-treatment/inclusion requirements.

terminal_objects.reality_check: Actual participation of previously underreached groups, process quality/staff ratios, language/development trajectories, exclusions/exemptions, family burden and later school-entry gaps.
terminal_objects.required_safeguard: Capacity first; transparent exemptions/accommodations and accessible high-quality provision.
